scope: Design supplement and offering the operator the timing choice only. No adoption, freeze, implementation, collection, calibration, market run or operations authority.

evidence.classification: SHOWN source and independently reproduced tiny probe
evidence.subject: Availability boundary
evidence.detail: HourlyPanel.window selects the 300 hours ending at close_ms and requires known_at_ms<=close_ms. Exactly-at-close passes; the final bar at close+1ms raises missing_or_unavailable_ohlcv:TEST-USD. This is an input guard, not measured feed latency.

evidence.subject: Timing recommendation
evidence.detail: The immediate next-open option is explicitly an idealized bar model with narrower claims. The proposed delayed option keeps the signal window ending T, allows receipts only through T+1h and models execution at T+1h. It does not promise physical execution at that open. The current API couples window end and availability cutoff: a future extension must separate them, not call window(T+1h) and accidentally include the later bar or overwrite actual receipt timestamps. Initial controls/evaluation boundaries and allocation/permission clocks require explicit revised protocol alignment before use.

evidence.subject: Missingness/status
evidence.detail: Unknown required marks, permissions or signal evidence remain INCOMPLETE; documented short listing history and known ineligibility remain distinct. rule_at requires knowledge by decision time, applicability at execution and one unambiguous rule. A public observation is not a valid-through interval/account entitlement. Excluding a missing-open order does not guarantee the whole bridge path stays COMPLETE if later required frame/signal checks fail.

evidence.classification: SHOWN selected source; financial conventions remain proposals
evidence.subject: Minima and cash rounding
evidence.detail: order floors quantity, applies adverse price to gross, charges fees on adjusted gross, then rounds buy debit up and sell credit down. The proposed USD0.01 quote quantum is separate from a product price tick and not certified settlement precision. Zero minima are proposed quantity-specified-market model inputs, not observed metadata defaults; no mapper or venue-compliance approval follows. Per-order conservative rounding is not a guaranteed portfolio-NAV bound when fill paths change.

evidence.classification: SHOWN saved-record consistency, not fresh collection
evidence.subject: Scope/evidence counts
evidence.detail: Bound metadata retains 25 candidate labels, 24 online and one dated MATIC delisted observation, without emitting model rules or trading permission. The bound archive result reports 21/24 and 0/24 complete full windows, and 24/24 and 22/24 final300 windows. These are saved audit summaries, not data authenticity, current warm-up or future coverage proof. No successor substitution is approved.

nonblocking_findings.detail: No network access was used, as requested. The three links identify official Coinbase Exchange documentation, but their live contents and the claimed June2022 order-size change were not independently retrieved in this review. The document author's source-reading claim remains CLAIMED; the zero-minima proposal is not certified as current product/account/API behavior. Before adopting a venue-rule mapper, bind the exact API/order form and dated primary evidence; do not generalize Exchange quantity-specified semantics to Advanced Trade, funds-specified orders or private entitlement. This does not prevent offering the timing choice.

verification.environment: VERIFIED_ENV local files/stdlib-only source extraction and synthetic rows
verification.probe_method: One inline AST-only execution of HourlyPanel and its accepted timestamp/schema helpers on 300 synthetic constant-price TEST-USD bars. No full reviewed module/strategy import, financial simulation or file creation for the probe.
verification.review_scope_not_reopened: Accepted bridge/ledger and original design/reviews were reused only as bound dependencies.

retained_limits: Neither timing choice is adopted by this review; the proposed fixed delay is receipt-cutoff compatible only when evidence meets the cutoff, not a processing/latency/fill guarantee.
Any idealized availability timestamp must remain explicitly modelled and separate from observed receipts; the strict accepted guard is not waived.
Status freshness/effective-interval rules, exact metadata/order API/minimum mapping, capital/cost/horizon/rounding and inference choices remain unadopted or unresolved before registration.
One venue/common quote/no yield or FX, and hypothetical full fills under explicit timing/cost/quantity/rounding conventions, remain the two model premises.
The complete 25-asset consideration scope and MATIC exclusion/no-POL substitution are retained; public status does not establish account eligibility.
No profit, power, execution capacity, data authenticity, live availability or broader research readiness is established.
